description: This PHP class 'FormatWithLocationId' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to provide formatted string representations of location identifiers by retrieving location data from a service.

classes.name: FormatWithLocationId
classes.description: A class that formats location IDs into location names using a location service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the location name for a given location ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Initializes and returns the LocationService instance.
